name: Commander Unblock Repair
goal: Unblock Commander worker spawning for roleplaying-agents without code changes: retire stranded reservations, clear CPU hogs, measure allocate, relaunch only if allocate fits the 60s cap.

tasks.name: Repair and relaunch decision
tasks.description: R1-R8. Subagent-sequential execution (operator choice): one Sonnet subagent, max_turns set. No tests required: operational repair, no code changes; per-step before/after evidence is the verification, recorded in the repair log. Exact-PID kills from the pre-kill snapshot only; no raw-SQL, forced-ref, or manual-cleanup fallback; any unexpected result stops for reporting; never touch Codex worktrees or pre-existing finalization/recovery/review-receipts refs. SP=/private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-roberthyatt-Code-ironclaude/7c7f63a0-e272-4e34-a05b-3d6ebc128c94/scratchpad. Full steps: human plan Task 1.

steps.description: R1 BEFORE stop: cat /tmp/ic-daemon.pid and /tmp/ic/brain.pid, record PIDs (if brain.pid absent record that, check daemon only); stop with Bash timeout 300000; AFTER: ps -p <daemon>,<brain> lists neither (exit 1) and printed 'Daemon (PID N) stopped' matches recorded daemon PID

R2 record sysctl vm.swapusage + uptime; pre-kill snapshot ps -axo pid=,ppid=,command=; kill set = PPID 1 + 'episodic-memory/dist/sync-cli.js'; kill <set>; ps -p <set>; kill -9 set survivors; verify all set PIDs gone; new post-snapshot matches recorded not killed; record swap/uptime after
steps.expected: every set PID gone; before/after recorded
exit 0; backup assignments count == live count

steps.description: R4 write 'SELECT workspace_guid,lifecycle_status,updated_at FROM assignments ORDER BY workspace_guid' to SP/assignments.before.txt; reap f9781678
R4 reap 55a08d1e; write same query to SP/assignments.after.txt; diff before/after
steps.expected: lifecycle_status cleaned; diff shows only the 2 guid lines removed, nothing else

steps.description: R5 CAS-delete branch 55a08d1e; verify for-each-ref refs/heads/ironclaude lists neither; moved ref -> stop and report

R6 uuidgen | tr A-Z a-z -> literal UUID; run allocate with run_in_background:true timeout:7200000 logging to SP/allocate-probe.log; no ps/sqlite3 against probe while running; on completion cat log, record 'real' secs, lifecycle_status, probe row created_at/updated_at, df -h repo. If killed at 7200000ms: record '>45s, killed at 2h', no relaunch, no reap, STOP and report

R6 reap probe (if reap throws STOP and report, no manual cleanup); record worktree list --porcelain, for-each-ref refs/heads/ironclaude refs/ironclaude/recovery/<UUID>, probe DB row; leftovers recorded not hand-removed

R7 if wall <=45s relaunch; verify cat /tmp/ic-daemon.pid + /tmp/ic/brain.pid, ps -o pid=,ppid=,sess=,command= -p <daemon>,<brain> both present, make PPID 1, launch log no Traceback/ERROR. Else no relaunch, hotfix next
